what: Development subset of the Isaac perception capture: RGB frames and per-frame ground-truth 2D boxes only (no depth, no instance-id arrays). Evaluation data; no detector or agent reads the gt field.
why_in_git: A cloud job runs from a git archive of the tracked tree; the 5 MB subset travels with the code so the job needs no extra upload. The full capture (depth, instance ids) stays under %LOCALAPPDATA%/DREAM/cloud_runs.
